q: What is the average temperature on floor 5 today?

stream.text:

**The average temperature on floor 5 today is 22.76 °C.**  
The highest recorded average among the 16 sensors was 23.14 °C from the Air Temperature Sensor installed‑node 5.18, while the lowest was 22.26 °C from Room 5.05 – Research Laboratory.  
The spread between the highest and lowest averages is 0.88 °C.  
All other sensors recorded averages between 22.57 °C and 23.07 °C, placing the overall mean squarely within that range.  
The average temperature on floor 5 today is 22.76 °C.

q: Compare the humidity in room 5.01 and room 5.02 over the last week.

stream.text:
<details>
<summary>Pipeline steps</summary>

- Analyzing your question…
- Querying building ontology
- Fetching sensor data

</details>

Comparing Wed 23 Sep 14:51 to Wed 30 Sep 14:51 (building time) against Mon 21 Sep 00:00 to Sun 27 Sep 23:59 (building time).

**HVAC Zone 5.01 mean**: 51.8 now against 51.5 before — up 0.282 (0.5%).
**HVAC Zone 5.02 mean**: 51.2 now against 50.8 before — up 0.34 (0.7%).
**HVAC Zone 5.01 peak**: 60.3 in both periods.
**HVAC Zone 5.02 peak**: 59.4 now against 59.5 before — down 0.13 (0.2%).
**HVAC Zone 5.01 lowest**: 43.4 now against 42.5 before — up 0.9 (2.1%).
**HVAC Zone 5.02 lowest**: 42.9 now against 42.5 before — up 0.43 (1.0%).

_Same basis in both periods: HVAC Zone 5.01 readings above the limit 0, HVAC Zone 5.01 sensors 1, HVAC Zone 5.02 readings above the limit 0, HVAC Zone 5.02 sensors 1._
_The basis differs between the periods (HVAC Zone 5.01 readings: 11096 → 9429, HVAC Zone 5.02 readings: 11096 → 9429), so the two figures rest on slightly different data._

_A difference between two periods is not by itself a trend: it can come from the weather, the timetable or who was in the building. Ask me to check it like for like and I will match the two periods hour by hour before reporting an effect._
